meetings.title: 3rd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, members discussed the information received from Maldives Fisheries and Ocean Resources Marketing and Promotion Corporation and Maldives Industrial Fisheries Company Limited. Since Maldives Fisheries and Ocean Resources Marketing and Promotion Corporation has informed on 22 nd August 2024, that the company's business plan would be completed within two months the committee decided to write up for an update on this matter.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In Today’s committee, the members reviewed the information received from Maldives Industrial Fisheries Company Limited and Maldives Fisheries and Ocean Resources Marketing and Promotion Corporation Limited. After reviewing the information’s, South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed to send a letter to Maldives Industrial Fisheries Company Limited to get more detailed information regarding the timeline (including the start and end dates for the projects) and an amount to be budgeted to the areas where there is a shortage of funds mentioned. It was seconded by Gan Constituency Member Yoosuf Nasheed. Hence, it was decided to send a letter to Maldives Industrial Fisheries Company Limited for additional information unanimously.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the appointment of the Committee chair and Deputy chair of the committee was scheduled. Director General, Shabana Rasheed presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed to elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Gan Constituency Member Yoosuf Nasheed. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed was elected as the Chair of the Committee. Then, South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed to elect Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Gan Constituency Member Yoosuf Nasheed. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. Then, South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by Maavashu Constituency Member Ahmed Shakir. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To decide the committee quorum as 3 members. Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 03 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 02 Result: Passed Hence, the committee quorum was decided to be 3 members.
